timeRanges.description: The time ranges to break in the chart.

label.description: The label to show for the break time ranges. This can be a translation key.

title:
Configuration type representing a set of time ranges to be visually "broken" or omitted in a timeseries chart.

This type is used to specify intervals on the chart's time axis that should be visually indicated as breaks,
such as periods of missing data, scheduled downtime, or other intervals that should not be displayed continuously.
The `timeRanges` property defines the list of time intervals to break, and the `label` property provides
a label or translation key to display for these break ranges in the chart UI.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartBreakTimeRanges
